proof_attempt_summary: Angle 0 was revised once at proposal review, passed at field tier, and ran one D0 solve round producing sound finite-game brackets, a benchmark-tracking interval sequence, a restricted 27/20 lower bound, and matched defect-adaptive length orders. A worked pinned-bridge calculation disproved exact conditional neutrality for that construction; anchored padding does not exhaust the unrestricted full-record game. The sharp asymptotic value and completion-exhaustion obligations remain open; independent maximality and validity consults found no bounded field-tier repair, so the result was banked downgraded at achieved tier incremental. No formalization or Lean verification was run.
tldr: Perfect prediction of the lower half of each potential-outcome margin eliminates the median rank-count variance under exact blocked assignment. Missing numerical outcomes still prevent exact median-effect recovery. The focal question is the evaluated sharp asymptotic value of \(nL_n(0)\), with coverage required over the entire defect class and risk evaluated at perfect classification. A completion representation must supply computably converging lower and upper certificates, legal full-record padding, observable lifting, and a total attaining interval sequence. Arbitrary spacings, unknown locations and both-arm label matching remain nuisance parameters. Simultaneous \(\sqrt{m+1}/n\) length orders are supporting results. The restricted erasure value \(27/20\) is a lower bound, not the proposed sharp answer. A formal information-fiber example separates individual-effect rank inversion from numerical median completion. An exact four-table, eight-record instance supplies a feasible lower dual and an observable globally honest upper lift; its explicit certificate gap is supporting calibration, not an evaluated asymptotic value.
gap: \cite{HanWang2026RerandomizationQTE}, Assumptions 6 and 8 and Theorems 3 and 5, excludes perfect rank prediction. \cite{MalinovskyRinott2011FiniteQuantiles} studies finite-population quantile minimax point estimation under rank loss. Neither inspected theorem evaluates globally honest connected median-effect interval length in the stipulated ordered-gap experiment. Classical stratified quantile intervals receive full credit; historical proof-level containment remains an access limitation. The stratified individual-effect inversion of \cite{SuLi2024} also does not encode the guarded marginal-median completion hull, as witnessed by Lemma \texttt{lem:individual-effect-inversion-fiber}.
fill: An evaluated sharp benchmark, certified through exact assignment games and lawful completion comparisons, would calibrate prospective median analysis after \texttt{randomizr::block\_ra}. A separate defect-blind interval would retain the appropriate precision order when the partition is imperfect. The first finite certificate and its full-record lift isolate the gap that an exhaustive sharp-value comparison must close.
